requirements.requirement: Convert staged ISO-8859-1 filenames into UTF-8 names under converted/, retaining directory structure and file contents.
requirements.summary: The two non-colliding Latin-1 names were converted to UTF-8 byte sequences as café.txt and résumé.txt. Direct comparisons and SHA-256 hashes show both destination contents match their sources, including after restart. The staged tree contained only top-level files, so its available flat structure was retained.
All three original entries remained under imported/ with their original raw filename bytes, sizes, ownership, modes, and baseline-matching content hashes; preservation was reconfirmed after restart.

requirements.requirement: Report any existing UTF-8 destination collision without overwriting the destination or silently dropping the source.
requirements.summary: The existing converted/plain.txt retained its distinct baseline hash, imported/plain.txt remained present with its source hash, and the durable conversion report explicitly records the collision and preservation action. These states persisted after restart.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel, using software compatible with the platform.
requirements.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 were unchanged from the lifecycle baseline through the recovered post-restart state. Conversion used the already-installed glibc iconv, and final package health remained clean.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct final-state evidence.
